ws-link-failed.area: websocket.js BannerManager (non-desktop shells: narrow web layout, Melaton Mobile before the app is up)
ws-link-failed.action: failed phase: a Retry button (manualReconnect); auth phase: the message is the content
ws-link-failed.note: N10: the one place a lasting failed / auth link is told on a shell with no connection dial; Connecting / Connected toasts removed (N1, N2). Hidden when the link recovers. Lost: none; needs Yukimi's call on a switch (issue filed).

nightshade-link-problem.action: click opens the Nightshade Network Client (toastManager _trayBalloonTarget, anchor nightshadeTrayIcon)
nightshade-link-problem.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notifications > Nightshade Network (trayRegistry popupId nightshade, trayPopupHidden)
nightshade-link-problem.note: N4, N5, N9: only a problem that lasted NIGHTSHADE_BALLOON_MS after the service was up; the 'Connected to Nightshade Network.' recovery balloon was removed (N2, N11); the problem balloon closes when the link is back.

high-latency.action: click opens the Nightshade Network Client (toastManager _trayBalloonTarget)
high-latency.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notifications > High Latency Detected (popupId high-latency)
high-latency.note: N5, N6, N9: one balloon per spell (10 min cooldown, was one per threshold crossing); the narrow-layout toast was removed (N11: the ping warning icon carries it). Kept as a judgement call: see 'needs a decision'.

boot-progress.action: content: the progress of the app starting that the user is waiting on (no click target; gone when init completes)
boot-progress.note: Not a notice but the loading indicator of the app's own start (N1: it is what the user is waiting for). Always one toast, updated in place (N6).

ws-user-request-failed.area: websocket.js request wrappers (metadata, index, character search, dictionary, cache refresh)
ws-user-request-failed.action: content: the failure of the request the user just made, named in the title
ws-user-request-failed.switch: n/a - a failure of an action the user just took is never switchable (N10)
ws-user-request-failed.note: N10: told once where it failed. The success toast of the cache refresh (N2) and the three lookup-while-typing error toasts (dropped by the toast policy anyway) were removed.

ws-config-refresh-failed.action: content: the message names the config that failed to load (a message box on the desktop)
ws-config-refresh-failed.note: A real server failure, broadcast to every client; kept (never remove a real failure). No switch yet: issue filed.

ws-request-progress.action: content: progress of a long request the user started; a progress dialog on the desktop
ws-request-progress.switch: n/a - progress of work the user started; it ends with the request
ws-request-progress.note: N1: data the user asked for; one progress toast updated in place (N6).

desktop-recycle-sound.area: websocket.js addScrap / addScrapBulk / deleteImagesBulk / deleteUnupscaledOriginal (desktopSounds recycle)
desktop-recycle-sound.action: content: the sound of the delete / scrap the user just did (hardware-click-like, desktop only, coalesced to one per batch)
desktop-recycle-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds: the Recycle event (None), No Sounds scheme, Volume Mixer for Melaton Sounds; desktopSounds off
desktop-recycle-sound.note: N7: user-action sound of the desktop scheme; never plays on Melaton Mobile (desktop only).

server-system-message.action: content: the server's message itself (a message box on the desktop, a notification on the phone)
server-system-message.note: N1: only level warning / error reaches the user now (info / success dropped). No server code sends it today (modules/websocket.js broadcastSystemMessage has no caller); the same warnings reach the phone inbox (notificationInboxSources). No switch: issue filed.

server-user-notification.note: N1: only warning / error type reaches the user (info / success dropped). No server code sends it today (broadcastUserNotification has no caller). No switch: issue filed.

agent-notice-toast.action: content: an agent's own message, sent on purpose through the developer-authenticated POST /agent/broadcast; restart and dialog variants are dialogs with buttons
agent-notice-toast.note: Raised only by a deliberate agent call (loopback, dev auth), never by the app itself. No switch: issue filed, needs Yukimi's decision.

deposit-receipt.action: click opens Account Manager Status (desktop wallet balloon, toastManager _trayBalloonTarget); the message is the content on the phone
deposit-receipt.switch: Notifications > Deposit Receipt (popupId deposit-receipt, desktop); the Accounts program on the phone
deposit-receipt.note: N1: Anlas arriving is data the user wants. The generation / upscaling / vibe / operation cost receipts were removed (N2: they restate a charge the user just caused; the balance shows it).

toast-progress-failed.action: content: the failure of the progress operation the user started
toast-progress-failed.switch: n/a - failure of work the user started (N10)
toast-progress-failed.note: N10: the phone's progress box closes and the failure is its message box; error / warning only.

toast-policy-balloon.action: first button, else _trayBalloonTarget of its tray icon (the program the balloon belongs to)
toast-policy-balloon.switch: Notifications settings per popupId (trayRegistry trayPopupHidden); each caller carries its own source id
toast-policy-balloon.note: Routing of a toast to its tray icon, not a source of its own: the caller's site carries the id. One balloon at a time per tray-balloons.mdc.

popover-pointer-shown.action: content: a tooltip-style popover the user asked for by pointing at or clicking the element
popover-pointer-shown.switch: n/a - shown only on the user's pointer, never unsolicited

popover-plumbing.area: popoverManager.js showPopover registration / global showPopover wrapper
popover-plumbing.action: none: delegation only; the calling site carries its own source id
popover-plumbing.switch: trayPopupHidden(popupId) is the switch this file enforces for every caller
popover-plumbing.note: Not an emit site: it enforces trayPopupHidden, records popupIds (trayNotePopup) and forwards the caller's call.

confirmation-dialog.area: confirmationDialog.js showConfirmationDialog on the phone shell (wmShell messageBox)
confirmation-dialog.action: content: the question or message the raising code asked, with its buttons
confirmation-dialog.switch: n/a - a dialog the user raised is not a notice; an unsolicited caller carries its own source id
confirmation-dialog.note: The phone's rendering of a confirmation dialog; not a source of its own.

confirmation-dialog-sound.action: content: the dialog the sound belongs to
confirmation-dialog-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds (the dialog / error / warning event, No Sounds scheme); plays only when the caller passes sound
confirmation-dialog-sound.note: N7: only dialogs whose caller asks for a sound (errors, questions raised by a user action); no caller in this file raises one on its own.

boot-message-box-sound.action: content: the box itself - Retry / Restart on a failed boot or logon step, the logon failure the user just caused
boot-message-box-sound.switch: Personalize > Sounds (error / warning / dialog events, No Sounds scheme); desktop only
boot-message-box-sound.note: N7: an error that stopped the boot, or the result of the user's own logon; never on Melaton Mobile.
